title: UAT-12643: Suspected North Korea-aligned actor blends blockchain resilience with targeted infostealing
description: Cisco Talos identified a financially motivated threat group, UAT-12643, using multiple payloads including the Go-based Overlord RAT, a Python infostealer called Good Game, and a cryptocurrency clipboard hijacker. The threat actor targets cryptocurrency holders, gaming platform users, VoIP software users, and finance/accounting staff, primarily in Europe. The Overlord RAT uses a novel command-and-control resilience technique by embedding encrypted server URLs in Solana blockchain transaction memos. Initial access is gained via weaponized Windows shortcuts, HTA files, and MSBuild XML files. The actor exfiltrates stolen data using Discord webhooks and uploads to gofile.io. The campaign shows low-confidence links to North Korea-aligned APT actors based on TTP overlaps and use of Overlord RAT variants previously seen in North Korean campaigns.
